text: This report will update the Board of Management on the primary activities and achievements of the Learning and Engagement Branch at the Toronto Zoo for the year 2021. Learning and Engagement oversees a wide variety of different programs throughout the year that support key components of the Strategic Plan and further educational goals. These include school program offerings and teacher resources, a roster of public programs for a variety of audiences/ages, virtual experiences, and summer camps.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Received the report (January 28, 2022) from the Senior Director, Strategic Communications and Guest Experience, Toronto Zoo for information.
